app_lock_create_content: Create a passcode to protect the app. If you forget it and haven't set a recovery email, you may lose access to your notes.
app_lock_create_title: Create a passcode for the app
app_lock_timeout_desc: Set the time after which the app should lock when in background.
app_lock_hide_recents_desc: Hide your notes on the Recents screen when you switch away from the app. Locked notes are always hidden from Recents.
app_lock_turn_off_desc: Are you sure you want to turn off the App Lock? Your unlocked notes will no longer be protected.
guide_intro: Everything **Notes** can do, where to find it, and how to use it.
guide_new_note_where: The **pencil** button at the bottom of any note list
guide_new_note_how: Start typing. The first line becomes the title. Notes save as you type unless {auto_save} is off in {settings}.
guide_text_styles_where: The **Aa** button on the toolbar above the keyboard
guide_text_styles_how: Pick **H1**, **H2** or **H3** for a heading or **Aa** for body text, then bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, a highlight or a text color.
guide_lists_where: The **list** button on the toolbar above the keyboard
guide_lists_how: Add bulleted, dashed or numbered lists, a quote, a link, code or a divider line.
guide_nested_how: **Swipe the line right** to nest it under the one above, and left to lift it back out.
guide_checklists_where: The **checkmark** button on the toolbar above the keyboard
guide_checklists_how: Tap a circle to check an item. To move checked items to the bottom on their own, set {settings} › {sort_checked} to {automatically}.
guide_tables_where: The **table** button on the toolbar above the keyboard
guide_tables_how: Tap the **dots** beside a row or above a column to pick it, and tap them again for its menu. With the caret in a table, the table button opens {table_actions}.
guide_undo_where: The **undo** button at the top of an open note
guide_undo_how: Tap it to take back your last change. To put it back, **touch and hold** it for {redo}, or tap the **redo** button beside it.
guide_find_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {find_in_note}
guide_find_how: Search the note, jump between matches, and replace one or all. {match_case} and {whole_words} narrow the search.
guide_markdown_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {import_markdown}
guide_markdown_how: **Paste Markdown** straight into a note, or import a Markdown file or an exported ZIP with its attachments.
guide_photos_how: **Tap** a picture to see it full screen. **Touch and hold** it to share, copy, cut, save or delete it.
guide_scan_how: Point the camera at each page. The pages are added to the note as one PDF.
guide_voice_how: Record, pause and tap {done} to add the recording. Tap {play} on the card to listen, or **touch and hold** it to rename, share or save it.
guide_transcripts_how: Your words appear as text while you record and stay with the recording. **Touch and hold** a recording › {copy_transcript} to copy them.
guide_files_how: Add a PDF or any other file up to **100 MB**. **Tap** it to read it, search it, or share, save and print it.
guide_copy_attachment_where: **Touch and hold** a picture or file › {copy}
guide_copy_attachment_how: Paste it into any note, or into another app.
guide_move_attachment_where: **Touch and hold** a picture, file or recording
guide_move_attachment_how: **Drag the card** out of its menu and drop it on the line where it should go.
guide_share_in_where: **Share** from any other app › **Add to Note**
guide_share_in_how: Pick a note to add the text, pictures or files to its end, or {new_note} to start one. A PDF opened in **Notes** from another app can be added the same way.
guide_math_where: Write a sum on a line and end it with **=**
guide_math_how: The note works out the answer. Choose whether answers are inserted or suggested in {settings} › {math_results}, or for one note in its **•••** menu › {math_results}. {settings} › {math_examples} shows everything it can calculate.
guide_math_notes_how: It opens the {math_notes} folder, where every note works out its sums. The **calculator** button takes you back.
guide_links_how: Pick a note to link to it. Type **/** right after the link to point at one of its headings. Tap a link to open the note.
guide_link_preview_where: **Touch and hold** a web link in a note
guide_link_preview_how: See the page itself before you open it. Tap the page to open it, or use {share}, {copy_link}, {edit_link} and {remove_link} under it.
guide_overview_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {summarize}
guide_overview_how: See the note's key points, tasks, dates, numbers and contacts at a glance. It works offline and runs on your device.
guide_detected_how: **Tap** a date to create an event or show it in your calendar, a phone number to call or message it, and an email address to write to it.
guide_cover_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {page_appearance} › {page_cover}
guide_cover_how: Top the note with a photo, a GIF, an image link, or any web page.
guide_background_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {page_appearance} › {background}
guide_background_how: Put a photo or a color behind a note's text. Blur and darken the photo so the words stay easy to read.
guide_text_size_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {page_appearance} › {text_size}, or {settings} › {appearance} › {text_size}
guide_text_size_how: Pick a serif face for your notes and make the text larger or smaller. The rest of the app stays as it is.
guide_read_only_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {page_appearance} › {read_only}
guide_read_only_how: Read without the keyboard opening or a stray tap changing anything, until you turn it off. Checklists **can still be checked**.
guide_folders_where: The **folder** button at the bottom of the Folders screen
guide_folders_how: Name the folder and give it an icon, an emoji or a color. **Touch and hold** a folder, or **swipe it left**, to edit, move or delete it.
guide_subfolders_how: Or move an existing folder into another one. Tap the **arrow** next to a folder to show or hide the folders inside it.
guide_pin_where: **Swipe a note right**, or touch and hold it › {pin_note}
guide_pin_how: Pinned notes stay at the top of the list and are gathered under {pinned} on the Folders screen.
guide_note_actions_where: **Swipe a note left**, or **touch and hold** it
guide_note_actions_how: Share, move or delete it. Touch and hold also offers {pin_note}, {lock_note} and {duplicate_note}.
guide_select_where: The **•••** button in a note list › {select_notes}
guide_select_how: Tap the notes you want, then move, delete, lock or export them together.
guide_sort_where: The **•••** button in a note list › {sort_by}, or {settings} › {sort_notes}
guide_sort_how: Order notes by date edited, date created or title.
guide_search_where: The **search bar** at the top of the Folders screen
guide_search_how: Find notes by any word in their title or text.
guide_trash_how: Deleted notes and folders wait here for **30 days**. Recover them, or delete them for good.
guide_tile_where: Your phone's **Quick Settings** panel › edit tiles › **Quick Note**
guide_tile_how: Add the tile once, then tap it to open a new note from anywhere.
guide_widgets_how: Show a note or a folder on your home screen, or a button that starts a new note.
guide_share_note_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {share_note}
guide_share_note_how: Send it as text or as a screenshot, copy it as Markdown, or export it as Markdown, PDF or HTML.
guide_export_many_where: The **•••** button in a note list › {select_notes} › {export}
guide_export_many_how: Save the selected notes as Markdown, plain text or PDF in one file.
guide_app_lock_how: Protect the app with a **6-digit passcode**, and choose how soon it locks after you leave. You can also turn on {hide_in_recents}, add a lock screen background and a recovery email.
guide_note_lock_where: {settings} › {note_lock} to create a password, then the **•••** button in an open note › {lock}, or touch and hold a note › {lock_note}
guide_note_lock_how: A locked note hides its text and attachments until the password is entered. {lock_now} in the note's **•••** menu closes it again right away.
guide_biometrics_how: Turn on biometric authentication to unlock without typing.
guide_recovery_how: Set a recovery email ahead of time, so a verification code can reset a forgotten passcode or password.
guide_delete_account_how: Choose whether your synced notes and backups in Google Drive go too, then confirm with the code sent to your email.
guide_sync_how: Sign in with Google to keep notes, folders and attachments the same on every device signed in to that account.
guide_sync_devices_how: Swipe a device to remove it from sync. If it asks to sync again, tap {manage} to answer.
guide_sync_mobile_how: Turn it off to sync over mobile data. Attachments that haven't downloaded yet show a placeholder you can tap.
guide_drive_how: Back up now, turn on {auto_backup} daily, weekly or monthly, and restore from one of your recent backups.
guide_local_how: Save a backup file on this device, or have one saved to a folder you choose on a schedule. Restore from a backup file here too.
guide_storage_how: See how much space your notes, pictures and recordings use, delete what you no longer need, and empty {recently_deleted}.
guide_theme_how: Choose {light} or {dark}, or turn on {auto} to follow your phone. {color} sets the app's accent.
guide_style_how: Choose {glass} or {classic} style for the look of the app. With {glass}, {reduce_transparency} draws solid bars and menus.
guide_start_with_how: Choose the style the first line of a new note is written in.
guide_language_how: Use Notes in any of its languages, whatever your phone is set to.
guide_tags_where: Type **#** before a word in a note
guide_tags_how: Tag a note with any word. Find your tags under {tags} on the Folders screen, and tap one or more to see the notes that carry them.
guide_custom_font_where: The **•••** button in an open note › {page_appearance} › {text_size} › {custom}
guide_custom_font_how: Tap {choose_font_file} and pick a TrueType (.ttf) or OpenType (.otf) font file to write your notes in it. Clear the file to go back to the default font.
guide_attachment_view_where: **Touch and hold** a picture, video or PDF › {view_as}
guide_attachment_view_how: Choose {small} for a compact row or {large} to show it in full. The **•••** button in an open note › {attachment_view} changes them all at once.
attachment_too_large_desc: Files larger than {} can't be attached to a note.
share_unreadable_desc: Notes couldn't read the file from the app it was shared from. Save it to your files first, then share it from there.

whats_new_summary_desc: See the key points, tasks, dates and numbers in a note at a glance, right on your device.
whats_new_glass_desc: Enjoy a glass-inspired interface with smooth animations. Switch back to the Classic theme anytime in Settings > Appearance > Style.
whats_new_glass_desc_classic: Enable the Glass theme anytime in Settings > Appearance.
whats_new_transcription_desc: Record voice notes and see your words transcribed as you speak.
whats_new_widgets_desc: Access your notes and folders right from your Home Screen.
whats_new_tables_desc: Organize information in neat tables right inside your notes.
whats_new_attachments_desc: Attach files and view PDFs right inside Notes.
whats_new_tags_desc: Type # before a word to tag a note. Find all your tags in the Folders list.
whats_new_widgets_new_desc: Start a new note right from your Home Screen with the Quick Bar widget.
whats_new_attachment_view_desc: Choose how pictures, videos, and PDFs appear. Select View As from an attachment's menu.
whats_new_fonts_desc: Import your favorite fonts and use them in your notes. Select Custom under Font & Size in a note's menu.
whats_new_fonts_desc_full: Import your favorite font and use it in your notes. Select Custom under Font & Size in a note's menu.
whats_new_background_colors_desc: Choose from more background colors for your notes.
whats_new_background_colors_desc_full: More background colors for your notes.
ui_style_reduce_transparency_footer: Glass and blur effects are turned off and a solid background is used. Recommended for lower-performance devices.
ui_style_rendering_footer: Low draws a lighter glass for slower devices. Reduce Transparency draws solid bars and menus instead.
ui_style_rendering_full_footer: Glass and blur effects are on. If you notice slowdowns, you can turn these effects off.
ui_style_rendering_unsupported: This rendering isn't supported on this device.
ui_style_effects_warning_message: The simple look was chosen for this device automatically. Glass effects such as blur and refraction may not run well on this device and can cause stutter and slower animations.
ui_style_fallback_message: Glass couldn't run on this device, so Notes switched to Classic. You can try Glass again in Settings under Appearance.
ui_style_glass_retry_title: Glass theme stopped responding on this phone. Try it anyway?
ui_style_slow_title: Glass theme is running slowly on this phone. Switch to Classic?
you_can_create_markdown: You can paste Markdown directly into the editor, or create a note from Markdown files and exported ZIP archives with their attachments.
tags_match_one: Show notes that match the selected tag: {}.
tags_match_several: Show notes that match {} selected tags: {}.
